_intake_note: Opus subagent findings, 2026-08-19. Internal map of autoresearch-et + malleus core concepts, for comparison against the four aws-samples repos. Locators verbatim.

paper.status_detail: VERIFIED NEGATIVE: no paper.md/.tex/.bib/draft exists anywhere in autoresearch-et. The 'paper' is positioning + related-work + methodology docs plus a plan for three FUTURE papers (POSITIONING:199-204: 1. ARCHITECTURE paper, 2. METHODOLOGY paper, 3. maybe the BIRD paper). Note: malleus-dev/paper/paper.md IS a real draft, but belongs to malleus.

thesis.text: A weak LLM + a persistent, typed, bitemporal knowledge graph + telemetry-gated meta-agents + pre-registered per-problem methodology can reach the same performance zone as a strong LLM with inline reasoning — and the KG lets us explain WHICH mechanism moved WHICH problem.

novelty_claims.claim: Bitemporal typed search-trajectory KG as the primary reasoning medium (vs ToT/GoT per-query discarded trees, GraphRAG corpus indexing, Zep/Graphiti conversational memory). Persists the LIVE SEARCH TRAJECTORY as typed LinkML nodes queryable from inside prompt construction.
Separate-cadence dreamer/regulator reading COMMITTED KG state, not live token streams; producer does not block on them.
Rule-based, EXTERNALLY MEASURED telemetry gating LLM meta-agent dispatch (vs MeCo's self-assessed score). 57.6% silence rate, bimodal per-problem.
Per-agent attribution from prompt to committed chain (systems engineering, not a headline claim).
Haiku 4.5 at 83-87/100 on Game of 24 via purely external scaffolding (ToT+GPT-4=74). Frame as evidence for the Snell test-time-compute thesis, not a surprise.
Methodological: pre-registration + gold-fixture + per-origin attribution as a replicable loop — 'closer to experimental behavioral science than ML benchmarking'.
novelty_claims.author_confidence: asserted, cost named ('some reviewers will not value this')

novelty_claims.claim: EXPLICIT NON-CLAIMS: not first at external scaffolding with small LLMs, graph-structured memory, multi-agent diversity, separate-system verification, or SOTA. Positive residual: the COMBINATION does not appear as a named pattern.

material_caveat.text: POSITIONING (2026-04-24) is partly contradicted by the project's own audit (2026-05-06): KG isolated per run AND per problem so cross-run/cross-problem learning is impossible by construction; similar_solved_examples never populates; vector store cannot .search() at runtime; producer prompt is a flat string with no graph traversal; KG algorithms have zero references in the producer path. 'Several deviations turn out to be bugs, not architectural choices.' A recon scoring autoresearch-et on claimed capability without this overstates it.

core_concepts_selected.definition: All loop state as a typed graph with valid_from/valid_to + t_created/t_expired; state-at-instant is a graph diff query (et.shift), not log replay.
No number in a report without a KG node id citation; uncitable claims are either not results or framework gaps.

core_concepts_selected.concept: Grounded audit rationales with hard reject
core_concepts_selected.definition: write_rationale resolves every cited node id before commit; missing id => raise + AuditFailure node. Rejected alternatives: flag-in-metadata, auto-repair.
Skip a candidate only when a near-duplicate exists AND its latest PromotionDecision was rejected; near-duplicates of winners still run. Skips recorded as typed decisions with edges.

Six precomputed read channels (sibling_branches, auditor_hints, similar_solved_examples, horizon, top_k_promoted, frontier) closing the write-only-sink gap. CAVEAT: similar_solved_examples never populates in practice (AUDIT-2026-05-06:14).
Deterministic coverage scan first; LLM call skipped entirely on empty report; fires on trigger predicate, not inline.
Open dict of normalized measured signals combined into weighted score; domain-extensible trigger factory.

core_concepts_selected.concept: Typed event bus with per-agent attribution
core_concepts_selected.definition: HintEvent (prompt-bound), PinEvent (frontier-bound, TTL), PlanEvent (atomic multi-step materialization), each carrying origin.
E013: dreamer identified the winning move on 6/7 lost problems but could only advise the prompt. Fix: pins into frontier selection, plans through PlanMaterializer writing chains atomically.

core_concepts_selected.concept: Regulator with SPEAK/SILENT gate one level above the producer
core_concepts_selected.definition: Reads telemetry brief; outputs SPEAK/SILENT (later TERMINATE/EXTEND/RESEED) + rationale. 'ReAct puts the controller inline; we put it one level up.'

core_concepts_selected.concept: Promotion by top-K membership; auditor as corrective
core_concepts_selected.definition: Warm-up over-promotion accepted openly; audit rejection expires the promotion.
iteration_cap mandatory; four stop conditions; reason recorded on the final Iteration node.
'ET decides nothing.' The four user callables never touch the KG client; orchestrator owns all writes.
hypothesis.md with P1/P2/P3 bands before API spend; missed hypothesis is a result; report.md records the honest verdict.
Pin the Regulator's commit SHA, prompt, skills, model, and its CAN/CANNOT-decide list — pre-register the controller, not the emergent parameter values.

core_concepts_selected.concept: KG must earn its keep — mandatory naive same-model control
core_concepts_selected.definition: Every new domain's first experiment includes a same-model no-loop baseline; loop losing to naive is a framework problem to flag.
Loop specified in prose in program.md; orchestrator implements it step for step. 'The contribution is the convention, not the code.'
Slot-fill default; when stuck detected, Regulator emits RESEED and a HolisticProducer emits one full artifact materialized as a pre-filled PartialState. Built because SQL semantics are holistic.

bird_work.summary: BIRD is autoresearch-et's second domain and main negative-result track (nine experiment dirs). Headline: pre-registered, honestly-reported NULL — EB02 on BIRD Mini-Dev 500: 223/500 = 44.6% EX (Haiku producer, Opus auditor, $15.93), vs pre-registered 50% minimum-viable and ~57% naive one-shot Haiku baseline (RoboPhD). Difficulty split: simple 62.2% (beats naive), moderate 39.1%, challenging 31.4%. Diagnosed cause is architectural: the 7-slot linear clause decomposition inherited from Game of 24 assumes independent subtrees, but SQL clauses are mutually constraining — the producer commits early slots before later-slot constraints are visible. Infrastructure half of the claim HELD: 11,737 PartialStates + 11,237 MergeSteps across 498 namespaces, 3,310 Opus audit events with ZERO AuditFailure nodes, every solved path reconstructable, same orchestrator unchanged (~1,100 domain lines vs ~12k core), $0.032/query producer-only vs RoboPhD's $0.51 (~16x cheaper). Later attempts did not recover the gap (EB05 46.7%, EB06 46.7%, EB07b 43.3%, EB09 36.7% = pre-registered P3 REGRESSION with mandatory halt-and-RCA). June campaign found plan-materialized BIRD terminals are never gold-executed at all ('the mechanism was unmeasurable, not merely ineffective'). RELEVANCE: benchmark overlap with the external text-to-SQL repo is real and direct (BIRD, execution accuracy); the honest comparison axis is not who scores higher but whether the external symbolic planner solves precisely the failure this project hit — global query planning under a decomposition that commits early clauses before later constraints are visible.

malleus_concepts_selected.definition: OntologyRegistry is the KnowledgeGraph's mandatory constructor param; every write validated BEFORE commitment; unknown type => op_status REJECTED with reason, no mutation. 'No registry, no KG.'
JSONL ledger is the authority; the graph is a defensive projection rebuilt by replay with recomputed bindings. Recon uses the same shape for literature review.
STAGED/COMMITTED/RECORDED are not truth claims; epistemic acceptance is a separate policy-bound event with precommitted monitors so a controller cannot pick a favorable policy after seeing outputs.

Committed and rejected attempts both logged; incomplete monitors recorded as MonitorFailure+UnavailableAssessment, never silently omitted; Prolog verification enumerates violations with witness ids; consult errors raise rather than degrade to SATISFIED.
Contract pins ontology hash, exact trusted rule bytes, rule ids, versions, timeout; fresh SWI-Prolog per evaluation; explicit non-claims (no sandboxing of untrusted Prolog, no proof certificates).
Non-exact ValidTime REQUIRES caller-extracted indeterminacy_reason; as-of views inside transition windows return INDETERMINATE and the graph property fails loudly.
Discipline decays without an auditor: mechanical CLI + assistant-level skill + shared rubric; every run prints the rubric used and disabled rites.

proposed_axes.axis: Position of the symbolic layer in the write path: admission gate at write time vs verification of output at read time vs no symbolic layer
proposed_axes.question: Can an invalid or ungrounded assertion ever enter the store and be read later?

proposed_axes.axis: Expressivity and pinning of the constraint language: type conformance, decidable DL entailment, Horn rules over compiled facts, or ad-hoc checks — and is the rule program content-pinned?
proposed_axes.question: What class of error can the system catch, and can a check's result be reproduced later?

proposed_axes.axis: Does a rejection produce a preserved typed record, or a silent retry/discard?
proposed_axes.question: Is the failure surface auditable; can rejection rate be measured over time? Ask each repo: what happens to attempt N-1 after a failed verification?

proposed_axes.axis: Does passing validation constitute acceptance, or is structural commitment held separate from epistemic acceptance and action authorization?
proposed_axes.question: Does a validated write silently become a truth claim the system acts on?

proposed_axes.axis: Persistence and reach of the reasoning trace: per-query discarded, per-session, per-problem-namespace, or genuinely cross-problem — scored on VERIFIED reach
proposed_axes.question: Does structure accumulate knowledge, or is it scaffolding rebuilt every call? (autoresearch-et's own audit shows claimed reach can fail in practice — score everyone on verified reach.)

proposed_axes.axis: Control of meta-reasoning: inline, deterministic every step, or gated dispatch on externally measured telemetry
proposed_axes.question: What decides WHEN the expensive reasoning component runs, and does that depend on LLM self-report? Discriminator: skip rate.

proposed_axes.axis: Does the meta/symbolic component's output reach the search mechanism, or only the prompt?
proposed_axes.question: Can the reasoning layer FORCE an action, or only advise? A symbolic layer that only advises looks neurosymbolic on the diagram and behaves like a prompt suffix in the ablation.

proposed_axes.axis: Evidence discipline: pre-registered bands with a same-model naive control and per-item attribution, vs aggregate benchmark accuracy
proposed_axes.question: Would this system's own authors have been able to report a null? Does an ablation isolate the symbolic layer at all?
